integrity.proof_method: exact double counting, strict convexity, complement incidence and inclusion-exclusion

scientific_limitations: The factorial-moment inequality does not imply any stochastic or expected-completion-time ordering.
The design equality criterion applies at ranks at most min(k,v-k).
The finite projective-plane statement assumes existence; no existence at unsupported orders is implied.
Generic finite-check arithmetic supplements, but does not replace, the all-order combinatorial proof.
Historical priority remains subject to independent assessment.
title: A design-strength hierarchy for uncovered-coupon moments
